analyze.how: Resolves the revision, computes or reuses each artifact in dependency order, and assembles the snapshot
analyze.name: Analyze a revision
analyze.what: Runs extraction and the requested interpreter stages, then writes the snapshot
analyze.why: The main path that turns a repo into a snapshot

api.how: Registers routes over a snapshot store rooted at the repo's .scv directory
api.name: Build the API server
api.what: Builds the Fastify app that serves snapshots, deltas and layouts
api.when: When the viewer starts the API

check.how: Compares current fingerprints against the committed .scv/semantics store, optionally against a base revision
check.name: Check committed semantics
check.what: Reports units, docs and tiers whose committed semantics are missing or stale
check.when: On scv check, locally or in CI
check.why: Gates PRs on up-to-date committed semantics

diff.how: Loads both snapshots and runs the differ
diff.name: Diff two revisions
diff.what: Produces a delta with risk between two analyzed revisions
diff.why: Shows what changed and how risky it is

export.how: Reads artifacts and writes per-unit semantics records into .scv/semantics
export.name: Export semantics
export.what: Writes the cached semantics for a revision into the committed store
export.why: Moves semantics from the gitignored cache into versioned files

hydrate.how: Reads the store at that revision and merges it over fresh extraction
hydrate.name: Hydrate a revision
hydrate.what: Rebuilds a revision's snapshot from committed semantics without analysis
hydrate.why: Lets any clone view a revision without re-running analysis

init.how: Writes or appends files into the target repo without clobbering existing ones
init.name: Initialize a repo
init.what: Sets a repo up for committed semantics: skills, agent instructions and the check workflow

merge.how: Validates the pending file and merges functions, docs, layers, groups or flows per flag
merge.name: Merge agent-authored semantics
merge.what: Injects agent-authored semantics into the artifact cache
